    BoardRenderer
    Renders the central board block of the game screen into the FXML containers it is handed: the two card rows, the offer track, the turn-order tile, the face-down deck and the future-era building decks.

    Game-state queries and input handling the renderer delegates back to the screen.
    EventsOverlay
    Full-screen orange wash shown while end-of-round events resolve: a big title plus one line per player parsed from the server log message.
    MoveHintBar
    The hint row at the bottom of the game screen.
    PlayerPanelsRenderer
    Renders the player panels around the board: the local player's panel at the bottom and the opponents' panels along the top/left/right.
